answer: Standing decay makes each fake pay to stay alive by itself. Every key holds an ember counter that halves each epoch unless the key burns a 12 POA pulse fee, and only keys with counter 8 or above pass the karst filter that gates emission. A fresh fake needs 6 epochs of fees to climb there, and a missed epoch erases the climb. 1,000 fakes x 6 epochs x 12 POA = 72,000 POA the attacker pays, burned and never refunded.
